column2: A white paper wall covered edge to edge in thick black marker doodles of cartoon animals with speech bubbles and words, hand drawn and naive, with a few pink and purple marker accents, like a giant sketchbook page.
A bank vault wall of brushed steel safe deposit boxes in a dense grid, each with a brass number plate and two keyholes, warm spotlights grazing the metal.
A convention hall wall covered in tall purple and yellow banners with the word VEE and FIRST TO SEVEN, trading card display cases with foil cards, a scoreboard screen, event lighting trusses.
A wall of dark volcanic rock with glowing orange cracks of lava running through it, embers, black basalt columns, steam.
The curved inner wall of a futuristic arena: tiers of seats full of flower headed fans in purple and yellow, LED ribbon screens that say VEE, spotlights, glass dome panels at the top.
A wall made entirely of wrapped gift boxes stacked floor to ceiling in gold, purple and white paper with ribbons and bows, warm festive light.
A gym wall with wooden bleachers, purple and yellow championship banners that say VEE and NEW YORKERS, a basketball hoop and backboard, bright gym lights.
A newspaper hall wall papered with colourful Sunday comic strips of flower headed characters and cartoon animals in neat panels with speech bubbles, a printing press in front.
A toy store shelf wall packed with boxed vinyl figures of cartoon animals in purple and yellow blank boxes, plush animals, price tags that say VEE, warm lighting.
A dark gallery wall that is a dense grid of small square pixel art portraits, 24 by 24 pixels each, every portrait a different character with a flower head, lit by LED strips.
A wine store wall: wooden racks from floor to ceiling full of wine bottles with blank labels, hand written shelf tags that say NEW YORKERS and MLOW, a pendant light, warm wood.
A stadium concourse wall in green and white: framed photographs of players with flower heads, a number 5 jersey in a case, pennants that say N3W, floodlight glow.
A wall of hundreds of vertical phone screens in a tight grid, each playing a different short video of flower headed people in New York, caption text in bold white, glowing cyan and pink.
